item.title: Notes from QuaSy-Con III
item.description:
Just returned from QuaSy-Con III at Iowa State University. Here are some thoughts and highlights from the conference.

The talks on module categories were particularly insightful, especially the connections to topological quantum field theory that several speakers explored.

Key Takeaways

  • New approaches to classifying exact module categories
  • Connections between fusion categories and TQFT
  • Computational methods for working with non-semisimple structures

Looking forward to incorporating some of these ideas into my own research on Taft algebras.
